payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: The woman brings the jacket's front panels together so the jacket is fully closed.
outcome.target: The woman's jacket front closure, assessed against the source image.
outcome.reference: The woman's jacket in the source image.

check.question: Compared with the source, has the woman’s jacket been closed at all?
check.complete_when: The jacket is fully closed in the edited image.
check.partial_when: The jacket is visibly more closed than in the source, even if it remains partly open.
check.absent_when: The jacket is not more closed than in the source; it remains open or is more open.
check.unknown_when: The jacket’s front or its state relative to the source cannot be assessed confidently.

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The jacket is open in both images; in the edited image its front panels are spread apart rather than brought together, so it is not more closed than in the source."}

parsed.evidence: The jacket is open in both images; in the edited image its front panels are spread apart rather than brought together, so it is not more closed than in the source.
